title: Rabbit Lands consistent menu icons
production_mode: Faithful recreation of existing HUD pixel style
processing: Only RGBA conversion and LANCZOS reduction to the existing 32x32 runtime tile size; no hand redrawing or replacement of original atlas cells. Full generation sources retained in ignored asset-authoring working stage.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE replacement 32-by-32 pixel fantasy RPG HUD menu icon, shown enlarged as a square. The three input images are PRIMARY EXISTING STYLE REFERENCES: inventory backpack, crafting anvil, world map. They are magnified copies of actual 32px game icons. Match their pixel scale, darkness, muted palette, silhouette weight, border proportions and quiet detail EXACTLY. This is faithful recreation of the existing set's style.
Presentation: One complete square tile filling the entire canvas, no empty margin. Match the references' very thin dull antique brass border at outermost edges, clipped reinforced corner joints, tiny midpoint brass studs, black extreme corners, very dark desaturated blue-green inset background. The main object is centered and occupies roughly the central 20 by 22 logical pixels, leaving about 4 pixels of quiet inset before the border. SAME FRAME WEIGHT, LOW BRIGHTNESS, and palette as the references. The background is opaque. This is a tiny low-resolution hand-painted pixel icon with broad blocky 1px clusters, not a detailed high-res painting; at intended size there are only 32 logical pixels along an edge. Sage gray, dusty parchment and desaturated muted brass highlights; deep blue-green shadow planes. Soft low-contrast matte shading just like the anvil and backpack, simple thickness and volume, legible filled silhouette. Keep the frame small and subordinate. No text, numbers, letters, watermark, glow, shiny gold, saturated yellow, white highlights, sparkles, clean vector outlines, thin line art, 3D render, busy ornament, extra icons, scene or UI. Output ONE complete tile only.
Subject/identity: A squat two-handled winners' trophy cup. Broad pale sage-gray pewter cup body with a quiet muted brass lip and short stem, small broad brass foot. Just one cup, open dark gaps in the thick handles. Simple front view. No podium, no ribbons, no laurels. Cup has the same sage-and-muted-brass balance as the reference backpack, not a solid yellow gold trophy.
assets.review: Complete readable filled silhouette; muted sage and brass shading, navy inset, thin worn brass frame. Reviewed beside original icons at 32px.

Subject/identity: MOUNTS menu. A compact horse head and upper neck in clear left-facing side profile. Broad pale sage-gray muzzle, strong simple jaw, two small pointed ears, thick dark desaturated blue-gray mane falling along the right edge of the neck. A simple dusty brown leather riding bridle with one restrained antique brass cheek buckle, thick enough to read at 32px. A calm friendly horse with a single dark eye, no teeth. Show head and neck only, with the lower neck ending naturally just above the bottom inset margin. Use the same sage-and-muted-brass color balance as the reference backpack and anvil. assets.review: Complete left-facing horse head and neck with muted sage coat, dark mane and brass-accented bridle. Matches original low-resolution shading and worn brass frame; inspected at menu size.
